# Pre-Registration

Please complete the pre-registration form before payment.

Final registration opens 10 days before the beginning of each course and is confirmed after payment.

[Open Pre-Registration Form](GOOGLE_FORM_LINK_TO_REPLACE){.btn .btn-primary}

## Information Collected

The form should collect:

- full name;
- email;
- phone number;
- country;
- selected course;
- preferred messaging channel: WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, or email;
- current background;
- motivation;
- payment status;
- questions or comments.

## Participant Instructions

After submitting the form, keep the same email address for payment and course communication. When final registration opens, use the PayPal link for the selected course and wait for the confirmation email before joining the cohort space.
